name: int64-widening-trap
description: A two-header window with a gap of 2^63 seconds — legal input, since NextTarget is clockless and the future-time limit is a node-layer withhold applied on some ingress paths only. The magnitude is taken in uint64 and clamped to maxSolve BEFORE a sign is applied, so the solve is +480 and the target rises. An implementation that widens the raw difference to int64 first wraps 2^63 to -2^63, clamps to -480, and lowers the target instead — a fork on a header anyone can send. No other vector in this corpus carries a gap within thirteen orders of magnitude of the wrap, so this is the only one that catches it. The direction is deliberate: the reverse window does not discriminate, as both readings land on the relative floor.
